phase_1.title: Phase 1 · Walther WA 2000 Trigger Release & Ignition Drive
phase_1.description: Pulling the trigger disengages the sear, freeing the spring-driven hammer or striker to impact the .300 Winchester Magnum primer.

phase_2.title: Phase 2 · 430 MPa Chamber Pressure Rise
phase_2.description: The propellant charge ignites inside the locked chamber, driving peak pressure to 430 MPa while sealing the cartridge case against the breech.

phase_3.title: Phase 3 · 650 mm Barrel Engraving & Acceleration
phase_3.description: The projectile engages the 4-groove bore and accelerates to 905 m/s (4820 J).

phase_4.title: Phase 4 · Short-Stroke Pulse & Operating Impulse
phase_4.description: Once chamber pressure decays safely, independent short-stroke piston delivers a clean impulse while isolating heat forward of the receiver.

phase_5.title: Phase 5 · Spent Case Extraction & Ejection
phase_5.description: The extractor pulls the fired brass clear of the chamber and pivots it out the ejection port while the recoil spring compresses.

phase_6.title: Phase 6 · Next-Round Stripping & Breech Lockup
phase_6.description: Driven forward by the recoil spring, the breech strips the next round from the 6-round supply and locks solidly into battery.

phase_7.title: Phase 7 · Disconnector Handoff & Sear Reset
phase_7.description: Releasing the trigger hands control cleanly back to the primary sear, leaving the Walther WA 2000 staged for its 25 RPM (Two-Stage Match Semi-Auto) cadence.

zh.headline: 瓦尔特 WA 2000 无托半自动狙击步枪：1982 年机械传奇与工程剖析
zh.deck: 慕尼黑事件后瓦尔特倾力打造的 WA 2000 彻底颠覆传统步枪形态：采用无托双铝合金纵梁框架，将 650 mm 比赛级 .300 Win Mag 枪管收进 905 mm 紧凑机身内；脚架从顶部纵梁倒悬，使重心与枪膛轴线几乎重合，后坐呈纯粹直线。 本馆以 1:1 真实工程比例重现其 20 大核心构件与完整工作循环。

acts.title: 时代召唤与研发立项：Walther WA 2000 的诞生背景
paragraphs: 1982 年问世的 瓦尔特 WA 2000 无托半自动狙击步枪 由西德卡尔·瓦尔特公司（Carl Walther GmbH）主导研制，定位为经典的艺术级无托半自动狙击步枪。因全手工精密造价极其高昂（1980 年代单价即逾 9,000 美元），WA 2000 仅生产 176 支便告停产，成为全球收藏界最具传奇色彩的现代精密狙击步枪。
慕尼黑事件后瓦尔特倾力打造的 WA 2000 彻底颠覆传统步枪形态：采用无托双铝合金纵梁框架，将 650 mm 比赛级 .300 Win Mag 枪管收进 905 mm 紧凑机身内；脚架从顶部纵梁倒悬，使重心与枪膛轴线几乎重合，后坐呈纯粹直线。 整件装备总长 905 mm（无托紧凑全长含 650 mm 枪管）、空重 6.95 kg，成为同期狙击步枪领域最具辨识度的里程碑之一。
acts.audioScript: 第一幕，时代起源。1982 年，西德卡尔·瓦尔特公司（Carl Walther GmbH）推出了划时代的瓦尔特 WA 2000 无托半自动狙击步枪。因全手工精密造价极其高昂（1980 年代单价即逾 9,000 美元），WA 2000 仅生产 176 支便告停产，成为全球收藏界最具传奇色彩的现代精密狙击步枪。 它的核心设计聚焦于独步枪坛的“顶置倒悬两脚架”让整枪如钟摆般稳定悬挂于枪膛轴线下方，奠定了其在狙击步枪发展史中的经典地位。
acts.focusPartLabel: 主体机匣与闭锁承力框架

acts.title: 核心机械构造与闭锁奥秘
paragraphs: 瓦尔特 WA 2000 无托半自动狙击步枪 的机械灵魂在于其「短行程导气活塞 · 七突笋旋转闭锁 + 顶部倒悬双轨浮置框架」结构体系。在发射工作循环中，独立短行程活塞瞬时脉冲撞击枪机框，将热负荷与振源隔离在机匣前方，将高压能量精确约束于承力框架之内。
制造工艺方面，关键承力件采用发蓝锻钢与油润精选胡桃木/桦木托精加工而成。无托结构将 650 mm 长距离狙击枪管压缩进 905 mm 城市反恐车辆适用全长，在严苛实战条件下依然保持顺畅节拍与长期尺寸稳定性。
acts.audioScript: 第二幕，核心机械原理。瓦尔特 WA 2000 无托半自动狙击步枪 采用短行程导气活塞 · 七突笋旋转闭锁 + 顶部倒悬双轨浮置框架。在每个击发周期中，独立短行程活塞瞬时脉冲撞击枪机框，将热负荷与振源隔离在机匣前方。借助发蓝锻钢与油润精选胡桃木/桦木托工艺与高强度配合，实现了无托结构将 650 mm 长距离狙击枪管压缩进 905 mm 城市反恐车辆适用全长。
acts.focusPartLabel: 高强度闭锁枪机头与抽壳钩

acts.title: 弹道性能、内膛工艺与实战效能
paragraphs: 该平台配用 .300 Winchester Magnum 弹药规格与 650 mm 重型凹槽浮置管 · 4 条右旋膛线（1:254 mm 缠距），最高工作膛压约 430 MPa，可赋予弹头 905 m/s 的出膛初速与 4,820 J 动能，有效作用距离达 1000 米。
内膛技术特点方面，650 mm 凹槽重管夹持于上下铝合金大梁之间，重心恰好悬于顶置两脚架轴线正下方。同时，下置短行程导气活塞 + 7 闭锁突笋旋转枪机，配精细胡桃木护片与贴腮板，令其在 25 发/分（两段式比赛级半自动） 的节奏下兼具精准控制与可靠输出。
acts.audioScript: 第三幕，弹道与实战表现。配备 650 毫米身管与 .300 Winchester Magnum 口径，瓦尔特 WA 2000 无托半自动狙击步枪 实现了每秒 905 米的初速与 1000 米有效射程。650 mm 凹槽重管夹持于上下铝合金大梁之间，重心恰好悬于顶置两脚架轴线正下方，展现了卓越的工程平衡。

acts.title: 人机工效、供弹哲学与百年遗产
paragraphs: 围绕 6 发容量的6 发可拆式双排弹匣壳体与 14 mm 膛轴设计，瓦尔特 WA 2000 无托半自动狙击步枪 将单发后坐冲量控制在 14.2 N·s 水平。总产量仅 176 支，每一支均由瓦尔特工坊手工精配，堪称现代轻武器藏品明珠。

acts.audioScript: 第四幕，百年遗产。凭借 6 发容量的6 发可拆式双排弹匣壳体与出色的整体工效，总产量仅 176 支，每一支均由瓦尔特工坊手工精配，堪称现代轻武器藏品明珠。欢迎在 BAY-71 展位亲手切开剖面、逐件拆解，感受 瓦尔特 WA 2000 无托半自动狙击步枪 的机械魅力。

acts.title: Origins & Operational Mandate of the Walther WA 2000
paragraphs: Introduced in 1982 by Carl Walther GmbH in West Germany, the Walther WA 2000 emerged as a defining Precision Bullpup Semi-Automatic Sniper Rifle. Because its bespoke hand-fitted construction cost over $9,000 in 1980s dollars, only 176 WA 2000 rifles were built before discontinuation in 1988, cementing its collector-icon status.

Born after the 1972 Munich crisis, the Walther WA 2000 wrapped a 650 mm fluted .300 Winchester Magnum match barrel inside a 905 mm twin-rail aluminum bullpup chassis suspended beneath an overhead bipod for near-zero muzzle flip. Measuring 905 mm (Compact Bullpup Housing a 650 mm Barrel) at an unloaded weight of 6.95 kg, it reshaped expectations across the Sniper Rifle class.
acts.audioScript: Act One: Historical Origins. In 1982, Carl Walther GmbH of West Germany introduced the Walther WA 2000. Because its bespoke hand-fitted construction cost over $9,000 in 1980s dollars, only 176 WA 2000 rifles were built before discontinuation in 1988, cementing its collector-icon status. Anchored by its hallmark design trait — Overhead-mounted bipod suspends the rifle like a pendulum below the pivot to minimize cant — it quickly established an enduring engineering benchmark.

acts.title: Core Operating Architecture & Lockup Mechanics
paragraphs: At the mechanical heart of the Walther WA 2000 sits its Short-Stroke Gas Piston · 7-Lug Rotating Bolt Inside Twin-Rail Top-Suspended Bullpup Frame. Throughout every firing cycle, independent short-stroke piston delivers a clean impulse while isolating heat forward of the receiver, containing 430 MPa of operating pressure safely.

Constructed in blued forged ordnance steel paired with oil-finished walnut, the assembly achieves durable field tolerances. Notably, Bullpup geometry packs a full 650 mm .300 Win Mag barrel into an urban-friendly 905 mm length, sustaining dependable operation under severe environmental stress.
acts.audioScript: Act Two: Core Mechanical Architecture. The Walther WA 2000 relies on Short-Stroke Gas Piston · 7-Lug Rotating Bolt Inside Twin-Rail Top-Suspended Bullpup Frame. During each cycle, independent short-stroke piston delivers a clean impulse while isolating heat forward of the receiver. Machined from blued forged ordnance steel paired with oil-finished walnut, it delivers standout engineering reliability: Bullpup geometry packs a full 650 mm .300 Win Mag barrel into an urban-friendly 905 mm length.

acts.title: Ballistic Performance, Bore Craft & Range Reach
paragraphs: Chambered for .300 Winchester Magnum with 650 mm Heavy Fluted Free-Float · 4-Groove RH Rifling (1:254 mm Twist), the Walther WA 2000 develops 905 m/s muzzle velocity and 4,820 J of kinetic energy for effective engagement out to 1000 meters.

Internally, 650 mm fluted match barrel floats cleanly between twin aluminum rails suspended below the top-mounted bipod pivot. Combined with its 25 RPM (Two-Stage Match Semi-Auto) tempo, Under-barrel short-stroke piston, 7-lug bolt, and hand-finished walnut panels exemplify German craft, delivering disciplined accuracy across demanding field conditions.
acts.audioScript: Act Three: Ballistic Performance. Driving .300 Winchester Magnum through its 650 millimeter bore, the Walther WA 2000 achieves 905 meters per second and 1000 meters of effective reach. 650 mm fluted match barrel floats cleanly between twin aluminum rails suspended below the top-mounted bipod pivot.

paragraphs: Fed by a 6-round 6-round detachable magazine body with a 14 mm bore-axis height, the platform manages 14.2 N-s of recoil impulse cleanly. Only 176 rifles were ever produced, making the WA 2000 one of the rarest precision arms on earth.
Now archived in Digital Armory 3D Centennial Gallery (BAY-71), all 20 interactive assemblies can be sectioned live along three axes, exploded to 100%, and inspected part by part.
